name: CPP_90_virtual_dtor_untainted
description: C++ virtual destructors (spec 016), NEGATIVE: the destructor sinks a member that was never tainted. A source exists (`tainted`) but never reaches the object; member `v` is set to a constant 0 and `~Derived(){ sink(v); }` sinks that untainted v at `delete p`. The destructor edge invents no taint the object never carried. s=none d=none agree.
label: Test
